title: Akka eval report
description: The outcome of one ExperimentRunner run: the gate verdict, the rates per evaluator, the spend, every case with its outcome over all runs, and every attempt with its evidence and results. An attempt is one case in one run; without repeated runs every case has one attempt. A reader ignores properties it does not know. formatVersion increments when a property changes meaning or is removed.

name.description: The name given with Experiment.name, or the test method that ran the experiment, for example SupportAgentEvalTest.qualityGate. The same name over several runs.

finishedAt.description: When the run finished, after the last attempt was evaluated, UTC.

runs.description: How many times every case ran. 1 unless the experiment set Experiment.repeat.

detail.description: The gate's verdict as text. A combined gate joins the detail of each part with a semicolon.

inconsistentCases.description: Cases with the outcome INCONSISTENT. Zero with one run.

inconsistentRequirements.description: Requirements that passed in some runs and failed in others, over all cases. Zero with one run.

evaluators.description: One entry per evaluator, in the order the evaluators first appear in the attempts, counting every attempt.

guardrails.description: One entry per guardrail, in the order the guardrails first appear in the attempts, counting every decision.

spend.description: Model responses, tokens and latency summed over the attempts with a recorded interaction. All zero when no attempt has one.

cases.description: One entry per case, in the order the cases were given, with its outcome over all runs and its requirements.

attempts.description: One entry per attempt: every case in the order the cases were given, its runs ascending.

evaluator.description: The evaluator component id. target is reported by the runner when the agent call failed.

guardrail.description: The configured name of the guardrail.

failed.description: Guardrail runs that threw instead of deciding.

outcome.description: Over all runs. PASSED when every run passed, FAILED when every run failed, INCONCLUSIVE when every run was inconclusive, INCONSISTENT otherwise.

requirements.description: One entry per evaluator at one position in the results of the case's attempts, in the order the results first appear. The runner's target result is a requirement too.

index.description: The position of the result in the attempt, from 0.

evaluator.description: The evaluator component id, or target.

outcome.description: Over the runs where the requirement was conclusive. INCONSISTENT when it passed in some runs and failed in others, INCONCLUSIVE when it was conclusive in no run.

passedIn.description: The runs with the verdict PASS, ascending.

failedIn.description: The runs with the verdict FAIL, ascending.

inconclusiveIn.description: The runs with the verdict INCONCLUSIVE, ascending.

notApplicableIn.description: The runs with the verdict NOT_APPLICABLE, ascending.

verdict.description: FAIL when a result failed, INCONCLUSIVE when no result failed and a result is inconclusive or no result passed, PASS otherwise. A not applicable result does not count against the attempt.

input.description: The command sent to the agent. A String command as is, any other command as JSON.

interactionId.description: The id of the recorded interaction. Empty when none was recorded.

reply.description: The agent's reply as text. Empty when none was recorded.

failure.description: Why the interaction failed. Empty when it did not fail.

latencyMs.description: From the start of the model call to its end.

modelResponses.description: How many model responses the interaction holds.

denied.description: Whether a guardrail denied content in the interaction.

guardrails.description: The guardrail decisions made in the interaction, newest first.

name.description: The registered tool name, <Class>_<method> for a function tool method without a name of its own.

arguments.description: The arguments as the JSON the model sent.

response.description: The tool's result as recorded. Empty when none was recorded.

name.description: The configured name of the guardrail.

boundary.description: Where in the interaction the guardrail ran.

decision.description: What the guardrail decided. FAIL is a guardrail that threw instead of deciding.

reportOnly.description: Whether the guardrail only reports, so the interaction continued regardless of the decision.

explanation.description: The explanation the guardrail gave. Empty when it gave none.

evaluator.description: The evaluator component id, or target.

detail.description: The explanation and the score, or why there is no verdict. Empty when the evaluator gave none.
